title: Norwegian Smørrebrød
description: A classic Scandinavian open-faced sandwich originating from Denmark, typically made with rye bread and topped with a variety of ingredients. This version features smoked salmon and a fresh tomato.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the flaky butter and let it melt.
Place the peppery rye bread slices in the skillet and toast for about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Meanwhile, slice the smoked norwegian salmon into thin pieces.
Once the bread is toasted, place a slice on a plate.
Top the bread with a few pieces of smoked norwegian salmon.
Slice the fresh tomato and place a slice on top of the salmon.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
